date: 17th Day of the Harvest Moon, Year 682 After Baronies Founding
title: The sacking of Tradub
author: Boon J. Cobson
content: Despair keeps sticking its head up in Snakefat. When our Snakefat Four joined the trade caravan to Tradub, they were met with a scene of horror. The town of Tradub had been sacked by an orc invasion, and the town was in ruins. They scouted out the perpetrators, and found that the orcs were part of a larger army. On their return to Snakefat, a council was called and it was decided to send out three parties, one to the neighboring village of Four Spears, one to the city of Swordshade to request aid of the baron and the last party to Diamond Lake. Our heroes set out to Diamond Lake, to warn of the orc invasion groups. When they arrived however they were met by disbelief, and the locals were not willing to believe that the orcs would be coming to their town. The Snakefat Four were however shanghaid by the baron of Diamond Lake and forced to investigate the lights coming from the Dwarven Stronghold that was silent for generations but now showed lights at night. While in the dwarven stronghold they came into contact with undead beings of millenia old and found out that this was not a dwarven stronghold but one of an even more ancient race long forgotten. The Snakefat Four were able to defeat the undead and escape their captors. Now they have fled the stronghold and are out and traversed the wilderness to return to Snakefat.
